notes.title: v1.0.2 released
notes.content:
[b]v1.0.2[/b] has been released!
It includes the following fixes

[h2]Fixed a bug in 5-7[/h2]
We have identified a minor bug in 5-7 that causes incorrect behavior of blocks when run in a specific procedure.
This is a different bug from the one resolved in v1.0.1.
It has been resolved in v1.0.2.

notes.title: v1.0.1 released
notes.content:
[b]v1.0.1[/b] has been released!
It includes the following fixes

[h2]Addition of restart button[/h2]
Previously, the restart operation was only available from the menu screen.
Starting with v1.0.1, you can now immediately restart by pressing the button in the upper right corner of the game screen or by pressing the designated key/button, just like Undo!

[h2]Fixed a bug in 5-7[/h2]
In 5-7, a bug was found in which blocks would overlap or buttons would be judged incorrectly in certain conditions.
This problem has been resolved in v1.0.1.
